MENU_SKIP: PRESS SPACE OR ENTER TO SKIP
REASON_CREW_ZERO: The crew's health has reached zero.
REASON_TRAIN_ZERO: The locomotive was wrecked beyond repair.
REASON_NO_TOOLS: A repair was needed, but no tools were available.
REASON_NO_FOOD: The crew ran out of food.
REASON_NO_WATER: The crew ran out of water.
REASON_NO_FUEL: The locomotive ran out of fuel for two consecutive events.
MINOR_RAIN_DESCRIPTION: Rain soaks the supplies and damages equipment.
MINOR_MOSQUITO_DESCRIPTION: A crew member develops a fever.
MINOR_TREE_DESCRIPTION: A massive tree blocks the tracks.
MINOR_MURKY_WATER_DESCRIPTION: Some drinking water has become contaminated.
MINOR_VEGETATION_DESCRIPTION: Something moves through the vegetation... But the crew discovers usable fuel nearby.
MINOR_RAIN_CATCH_DESCRIPTION: The crew collects rainwater in every barrel they can find.
MINOR_WOODPILE_DESCRIPTION: Firewood stacked beside the tracks by a previous crew.
MINOR_LOOSE_CARGO_DESCRIPTION: A sudden jolt sends unsecured supplies crashing against the carriage walls.
MINOR_TRACKSIDE_CACHE_DESCRIPTION: The crew discovers a forgotten crate of useful equipment beside the railway.
MINOR_FOOD_SHORTAGE_DESCRIPTION: The food stores are running dangerously low.
MINOR_WATER_SHORTAGE_DESCRIPTION: The remaining drinking water will not last much longer.
MINOR_PROVISION_CRATE_DESCRIPTION: A sealed crate has been left beside the railway. Some of its contents are still usable.
MINOR_LEAKING_CASK_DESCRIPTION: One of the water barrels has cracked. Several litres have already been lost.
MAJOR_BROKEN_ENGINE_DESCRIPTION: The locomotive has suffered a mechanical failure. The crew needs spare tools to get it moving again.
MAJOR_BROKEN_ENGINE_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_1_D: The engine roars back to life.
MAJOR_BROKEN_ENGINE_CHOICE_2_OUTCOME_2_D: The patch barely holds and the engine is badly strained.
MAJOR_EMBANKMENT_DESCRIPTION: The ground beneath the railway is collapsing.
MAJOR_EMBANKMENT_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_2_DESC: The repairs fail. Someone gets hurt.
MAJOR_EMBANKMENT_CHOICE_3_OUTCOME_1_DESC: The crew waits for safer conditions.
MAJOR_FEVER_DESCRIPTION: A passenger has developed a severe fever.
MAJOR_RIVERBANK_DESCRIPTION: A maintained trail leads into the forest. Someone lives nearby.
MAJOR_RIVERBANK_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_1_DESCR: The crew records the trail and leaves it undisturbed.
MAJOR_RIVERBANK_CHOICE_2_OUTCOME_1_DESCR: The train continues along the railway.
MAJOR_ROARING_DESCRIPTION: The river's rapids shake the cargo as the train passes nearby.
MAJOR_ROARING_CHOICE_2_OUTCOME_2_DESCRIP: Some supplies fall from the cargo.
MAJOR_OLD_CAMP_DESCRIPTION: The crew discovers the remains of an old construction camp.
MAJOR_OLD_CAMP_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_1_DESCRI: Useful equipment and food are recovered.
MAJOR_OLD_CAMP_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_2_DESCRI: The camp has already been emptied.
MAJOR_OLD_CAMP_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_3_DESCRI: An accident injures a crew member.
MAJOR_RIVER_BEND_TEXT: A Quiet Bend in the Madeira
MAJOR_RIVER_BEND_DESCRIPTION: The river runs calm here. The barrels could use a refill.
MAJOR_RIVER_BEND_CHOICE_1_TEXT: Boil the water before storing it
MAJOR_RIVER_BEND_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_1_DESC: The water is clean and the barrels are full.
MAJOR_RIVER_BEND_CHOICE_2_TEXT: Fill the barrels straight from the river
MAJOR_RIVER_BEND_CHOICE_2_OUTCOME_1_DESC: The water looks clear enough. The barrels are full.
MAJOR_RIVER_BEND_CHOICE_2_OUTCOME_2_DESC: The water was foul. Most of it is unusable and the crew falls ill.
MAJOR_RIVER_BEND_CHOICE_3_OUTCOME_1_DESC: The train rolls on past the river.
MAJOR_DERELICT_LOCO_DESCRIPTION: A rusted locomotive sits abandoned on a siding. Its tender may still hold fuel.
MAJOR_DERELICT_LOCO_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_1_D: The tender still holds plenty of usable fuel.
MAJOR_DERELICT_LOCO_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_2_D: Mostly rust and ash, but a little fuel is salvaged.
MAJOR_DERELICT_LOCO_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_3_D: Part of the wreck collapses. Someone gets hurt, but some fuel is saved.
MAJOR_BOILER_PRESSURE_DESCRIPTION: The boiler pressure is rising beyond its normal operating range. The engineer needs to act quickly.
MAJOR_BOILER_PRESSURE_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_1: The engineer releases the pressure. The boiler returns to normal.
MAJOR_BOILER_PRESSURE_CHOICE_2_OUTCOME_1: The reinforcement holds. The engine is safe.
MAJOR_BOILER_PRESSURE_CHOICE_2_OUTCOME_2: The valve gives way during the repair. The train suffers damage.
MAJOR_BOILER_PRESSURE_CHOICE_3_TEXT: Continue travelling and hope for the best
MAJOR_BOILER_PRESSURE_CHOICE_3_OUTCOME_2: The boiler overheats. The locomotive suffers serious damage.
MAJOR_TRACK_WASHOUT_DESCRIPTION: Heavy rain has damaged the ground supporting the tracks. The locomotive cannot proceed safely without a decision.
MAJOR_TRACK_WASHOUT_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_1_D: The crew reinforces the railway successfully.
MAJOR_TRACK_WASHOUT_CHOICE_1_OUTCOME_2_D: The ground gives way during the work. The locomotive is damaged.
MAJOR_TRACK_WASHOUT_CHOICE_2_TEXT: Wait for the water to recede
MAJOR_TRACK_WASHOUT_CHOICE_2_OUTCOME_1_D: The crew waits for safer conditions, consuming precious provisions.
MAJOR_TRACK_WASHOUT_CHOICE_3_OUTCOME_1_D: The locomotive crosses the damaged section carefully.
MAJOR_TRACK_WASHOUT_CHOICE_3_OUTCOME_2_D: The weakened ground damages the locomotive during the crossing.
